title: introduce-forecasted-batch-shaper-cli
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context and motivation: Tenant teams frequently hit tradeoffs between latency SLOs and unit cost because current batch/cache defaults are static and reactive. This PR introduces a new CLI-driven workflow and small runtime hook that converts short-term tenant workload forecasts into tuned batching, cache and quantization presets. The goal is to automate safe, measurable saving suggestions and enable rapid dry-runs in sandbox before any rollout.

What this PR delivers: rwd-econ-shaper CLI (Go): consumes historical telemetry + 7-day forecast (CSV/JSON), simulates continuous-batching and prefix-cache efficiency, and produces an ordered list of recommended presets (batch shapes, cache TTLs, quantization profile hints) with an estimated delta on per-token cost and 95th latency. The CLI also emits a compact policy bundle that can be uploaded as a tenant override via the existing admin API.

Key design notes: 1) Forecast-first: simulator accepts per-tenant arrival-rate forecasts (per-minute) and uses the same service-side batching model to estimate microburst impact. 2) Conservative fallbacks: recommendations include a safe baseline and a risk score; operator must opt-in to aggressive profiles. 3) Quant profiles are suggested, not forced — the runtime will only apply quantization variants if tenant policy permits. 4) Unit economics: the estimator reports delta in cost/token and projected monthly savings at current traffic. 5) Telemetry and audit: every generated bundle is accompanied by a deterministic signature and simulation snapshot for reproducibility.

Files and surface changes (high level): - cmd/rwd-econ-shaper/main.go: new CLI, help/man pages, JSON/CSV parsers. - internal/econ/simulator/*: simulator core (traffic model, batching estimator, cache model). - internal/econ/quant_hints.go: quant profile heuristics and safety checks. - runtime/config/tenant_overrides.go: small hook to accept safe bundle metadata (no runtime enforcement change). - api/admin/v1/tenant_overrides.go: endpoint to validate and stage bundles. - docs/cli/econ-shaper.md: usage examples and rollback guidance. - tests/econ: unit tests for simulator, integration test harness with local runtime stub.

Commits (summary): - feat(cli): initial rwd-econ-shaper skeleton and argument parsing - feat(sim): implementation of forecast-driven batching simulator - feat(econ): quantization hint generator and risk scoring - feat(api): extend tenant overrides validation endpoint - test: add unit and integration tests and CI workflows - docs: usage guide and template forecast files - ci: add Github Actions workflow for CLI build and smoke test

Checklist: [x] Unit tests for simulator core [x] Integration test that validates bundle upload [x] Doc entry with example forecast [x] Telemetry events instrumented for simulation runs [x] Linear tickets referenced: ENG-1515 (simulator), PM-213 (UX/workflow)

Testing and CI: The new GH Actions job runs cross-platform builds, unit tests, and a quick end-to-end that runs the CLI against a local runtime stub. CI initially flagged a flaky test (TestBatchShapeEdgeCases) — fixed by increasing timeout and adding tighter deterministic seed. Final CI status: pass.

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag econ.shaper.enabled=false. 2) Internal dry-run: engineering can run CLI in staging to generate bundles and validate telemetry; no live tenant changes. 3) Tenant opt-in by admins: admin API accepts staged bundles and applies them in a canary group (10% of traffic) with automated rollback if 95th latency regresses > 10%. 4) Monitor: create dashboards (prefill:dash/econ-shaper) and alerts (SLO regression, cache hit rate delta).

Backward compatibility and safety: The runtime default behavior unchanged. Bundles are advisory until an admin uploads and promotes them. Quantization hints are gated by tenant policy and require explicit acknowledgement for aggressive profiles.

Telemetry and observability: Emitted events: econ.shaper.run (success/failure), econ.shaper.simulation_snapshot_id, econ.shaper.recommendation_bundle_id. Dashboards and alert runbooks included in docs/cli/econ-shaper.md.

Related work: complements tenant-warmstart and prefill automations; design intentionally avoids automatic application without explicit opt-in.

Known limitations and future work: - Forecast quality sensitive: next PR will add an optional forecast quality estimator. - Auto-apply alpha guarded: we plan an experimental auto-apply pipeline with manual guardrails after additional experimentation.

Merge notes: Squash-merging after approvals. Change set kept intentionally scoped to CLI + validation hook; no automatic runtime application included in this PR.

review_comments: Benji Huang: Nice end-to-end. Two asks: 1) please add a smoke test verifying bundle signature is stable across runs, 2) clarify risk scoring math (percentiles vs. stddev).
Aisha Patel: Addressed both — added deterministic snapshot signature and expanded doc on risk scoring (now percentile+tail penalty).
Marta O'Neill: Could we gate the CLI so it only runs when forecast file has >= 7 days? Also request to include an example of tenant override JSON.
Aisha Patel: Added validation for minimum forecast horizon and included example override in docs/fixtures. Also added clearer errors for malformed forecasts.
Devon Park: CI showed flakiness in TestBatchShapeEdgeCases; increase seed determinism and timeout looked good. Approving pending squash and changelog entry.
Benji Huang: Approved. Verified E2E against staging runtime stub and reviewed simulated cost deltas (savings estimates conservative).
ci_checks: integration-smoke: runs CLI against local stub - pass
release_notes: Add rwd-econ-shaper CLI: forecast-driven batch/cache/quant recommendation tool; safe policy bundle export; admin API validation. Feature behind feature flag. Non-breaking.
notes_for_oncall: If tenants report latency regressions after applying a bundle, revert by removing tenant override and follow econ-shaper runbook in docs/cli/econ-shaper.md. Watch dash prefill:dash/econ-shaper and alert econ:latency-regressions.
manual_steps: To run locally: make build && ./bin/rwd-econ-shaper --forecast sample_forecast.json --out recommendations.json
To stage bundle: curl -X POST /admin/v1/tenant_overrides -d @recommendations.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>'
